daemonize.description: Whether to run daemon in background.

fail.description: Whether to exit if module loading fails.

allow_module_loading.description: Whether to allow runtime module loading.

allow_exit.description: Whether to allow clients to request daemon shutdown.

use_pid_file.description: Whether to create and use a PID file.

system_instance.description: Whether to run as a system-wide instance.

local_server_type.description: Server type for local connections: 'user' or 'system'.

enable_shm.description: Whether to use shared memory for data exchange.

enable_memfd.description: Whether to use memfd for shared memory.

shm_size_bytes.description: Shared memory size in bytes (0 = use system default, usually 64 MiB).

high_priority.description: Whether to run with high priority (requires privileges).

nice_level.description: Nice level for the daemon process.

exit_idle_time.description: Seconds of idle time before daemon exits (0 = disabled).

scache_idle_time.description: Seconds of idle time before sample cache is freed (0 = disabled).

load_default_script_file.description: Whether to load the default script file at startup.

default_script_file.description: Path to the default script file.

log_target.description: Log target: 'syslog', 'stderr', 'journal', 'auto', or path to file.

log_meta.description: Whether to include source location in logs.

log_time.description: Whether to include timestamp in logs.

log_backtrace.description: Maximum stack trace lines to include on fatal errors.

avoid_resampling.description: Whether to avoid resampling whenever possible.

enable_remixing.description: Whether to remix audio to match sink channel map.

remixing_use_all_sink_channels.description: Whether to use all sink channels in remixing.

remixing_produce_lfe.description: Whether to produce LFE channel during remixing.

remixing_consume_lfe.description: Whether to consume LFE channel during remixing.

lfe_crossover_freq.description: LFE crossover frequency in Hz (0 = disabled).

flat_volumes.description: Whether to flatten volume levels (set all volumes equally).

rescue_streams.description: Whether to move streams to available sinks on sink failure.

rlimit_fsize.description: File size limit in bytes (-1 = unlimited).

rlimit_locks.description: Max number of file locks (-1 = unlimited).

rlimit_sigpending.description: Max number of pending signals (-1 = unlimited).

rlimit_msgqueue.description: Max bytes in message queues (-1 = unlimited).

rlimit_rttime.description: Max CPU time for real-time tasks in microseconds.

alternate_sample_rate.description: Alternate sample rate in Hz for compatible hardware.

default_fragments.description: Default number of fragments for period-based buffering.

enable_deferred_volume.description: Whether to use deferred volume updates.

deferred_volume_safety_margin_usec.description: Safety margin in microseconds for volume smoothing.

deferred_volume_extra_delay_usec.description: Extra delay in microseconds for volume updates.
